Variants.Content: During the Punic Wars, the Roman manipular legion operated in the famed Triplex Acies formation. Arranged in a checkerboard quincunx of Hastati (youths), Principes (prime veterans), and Triarii (spear-armed elders), frontline units exhausted by melee could orderly retire through gaps in the rear lines while fresh cohorts stepped forward, presenting an elastic wall of steel.
